profile.headline: Principal Software Developer and Team Lead, Growth at Atlassian
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of success in the software industry. Strong information technology professional skilled in C++, JavaScript, Electron, Node, Qt, and build tooling.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer and Team Lead, Growth
positions.description: Team lead for the Growth - Land team at Atlassian. Lead a team that crafts experiments, rolls them out, and uses data to evaluate their success. Works on increasing team capability and velocity.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer, Trello
positions.description:
Tech Lead for the Trello Front End Platform team which maintains the Trello front end architecture
Planned and implemented a tech debt score system which used static analysis to measure various categories of debt and assigned them to teams via their ownership areas
Wrote implementation specs and project plans which were carried out by multiple subteams
Directed a cross functional (mobile, server, and web) project to clean up stale feature flags and the associated tech debt across all of Trello
Advised on and led multiple projects spanning work areas like compliance, security, observability, and incident management and response

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Trello Web and Desktop
positions.description:
Maintained and improved the Trello Desktop application using Electron and Javascript
Optimized a CI/CD pipeline that built Windows, Mac, and Linux targets
Managed automatic updates for internal (beta) and external customers
Led incident responses on multiple occasions to increase stability and reliability of Trello web
Determined my own roadmap and conducted user research to decide which desktop features to build
Led the Trello web release rotation enhancing observability and alerting
Improved the Trello web CI/CD build to reduce time to delivery from 60 to 20 minutes with increased testing and reliability

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Stride Desktop
positions.description:
Technologies Used: JavaScript, Electron, React, CSS, Node, Bamboo, Windows, OS X, Linux, git

Created the Stride Desktop applications for Windows, Mac OS X, and Linux using Electron.
Set up a build infrastructure in Bamboo to validate, build, and deploy the Stride desktop applications using Continuous Integration best practices.
Designed and implemented a custom update strategy that allowed Atlassian to use a prerelease
version of Stride without affecting production customers.
Created a custom unit testing framework for Electron and Jasmine that resulted in over 90% coverage.

positions.title: Team Lead - HipChat Desktop
positions.description:
Technologies used: C++, JavaScript, Qt, React, CSS, Node, Bamboo, Windows, Linux, git

Developed Hipchat on Windows and Linux using QtWebEngine, a web wrapped technology.
Used a combination of C++ and JavaScript / Node to make a hybrid web and native desktop application.
Lead the desktop team which included four direct reports.
Designed and implemented the long term plan to rewrite the desktop application.
